name: Coal-Cat

Traits.name: Ember Wound
Traits.text: The first time the coal-cat is Bloodied in a fight, it releases a burst. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the coal-cat. *Failure:* 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.
Traits.minorClause: , and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the coal-cat fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The coal-cat regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the coal-cat takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function on the coal-cat's next turn. The coal-cat dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The coal-cat makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Smoldering Menace.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage.

Actions.name: Smoldering Menace
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the coal-cat's next turn. If the target was already Frightened by this ability, it also takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the coal-cat can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Stalk and Strike
Legendary Actions.text: The coal-cat moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Claw attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Cinder Glare
Legendary Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.name: Coalscatter
Legendary Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet of the coal-cat. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

lore: A coal-cat is a feral beast kindled in the smoldering slag-heaps of ruined forges, hunting the warmth of living things to feed the banked fire inside it.
